intro.text: A form of exercise that Lord Shuden performs for Sarene's fencing group, who are impressed, though he insists he is only an amateur.

A fighting art of circling, dance-like movements that draws on the Dor, giving the user great strength and a sense of their surroundings even with eyes closed. Lord Shuden, who called himself an amateur, fights with it.

description.text: The user moves in set circular patterns that slowly speed up, hands and feet never still and muscles tense, as if pushing against something unseen; the leaps and sweeping arms look like a dance. While the Dor is truly being reached, a faint glow trails the limbs. If the user's focus slips, the link to the Dor is lost and they must begin again.

It grants huge strength: a user can break a Dakhor monk's ribs, or strike one's head hard enough to snap its spine, though those monks are so tough that even Kiin's axe needs several blows to kill one. It also gives an instinctive sense of space, and Shuden fights with his eyes shut.
